beats.text: Did you know a chatbot reportedly nearly pushed the United States into a clash with China? Yes, really.
beats.image_prompt: Cinematic vertical shot of a massive dark cargo ship at night on a stormy ocean, glowing red warning light on the horizon, dramatic moody lighting, no text

beats.text: An intelligence analyst fed a Chinese cargo ship's paperwork into an AI chatbot. It answered that the ship carried nuclear weapons parts headed for Iran.
beats.image_prompt: Close-up of a glowing computer screen in a dark military command room, lines of data reflected on a worried analyst's silhouette, cold blue light, cinematic, no text

beats.text: That claim climbed the chain as a real report. Aircraft and armed boarding teams were readied to intercept the ship.
beats.image_prompt: Military helicopter and fast boat teams preparing at dawn on a naval base, dramatic orange sky, tense atmosphere, cinematic vertical composition, no text

beats.text: Then officials found the source was a chatbot, and the operation was stopped. Reporters could not even confirm what the ship was really carrying.
beats.image_prompt: A hand pressing a big red stop button in a dim control room, shallow depth of field, tense cinematic lighting, no text

beats.text: One source said AI helps you get to a bad idea faster. Scary, right? For more videos like this, like and follow.
beats.image_prompt: A glowing humanoid robot head made of circuit patterns looming over a tiny globe, neon purple and blue, futuristic cinematic scene, no text
